chunks: Muhammad, from Ahmad, from Al-Husayn ibn Saeed, from Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Al-Qasim ibn Sulayman, from Ubayd ibn Zurara, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), regarding

a man who married a woman and set her father as her dower, and the value of her father was five hundred dirhams, on condition that she would give him one thousand dirhams. Then he divorced her before entering into her. He (peace be upon him) said: There is nothing upon her.

key_terms.لَيْسَ عَلَيْهَا شَيْ‏ءٌ: there is nothing upon her (she owes nothing)

ai.seo_question: What is the dower ruling for a woman divorced before consummation when the dower was her father's value with a condition?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi clarifies the financial liability of a woman divorced before consummation when the dower was structured as a conditional debt to her father. Imam al-Sadiq (AS) rules that she owes nothing, highlighting the Shia juristic view that pre-consummation divorce nullifies the specific conditional dower arrangement, distinguishing it from the general half-dower rule. This ruling underscores the principle that the husband's right to the dower is contingent upon the completion of the marital bond or the fulfillment of specific agreed conditions.

en.hubeali: Muhammad, from Ahmad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Nazar Bin Suwed, from Al Qasim Bin Suleyman, from Ubeyd Bin Zurara,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding a man who married a woman, and set her father as her dower, and the value of her father was five hundred Dirhams upon that she would give him a thousand Dirhams. Then he divorced her before he slept with her. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is nothing upon her’.
en.sarwar: 10. Muhammad has narrated from Ahmad from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from al-Qasim ibn Sulayman from ‘Ubayd ibn Zurarah who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about

the case of a man who marries a woman and sets her (slave) father as her mahr (dower). His price is five hundred dirham; then he divorces before going to bed with her.’ He (the Imam) said, ‘She does not owe anything to him.’”
